english_source_note: Riemann Integral and Criteria for Integrability
callout_id: 黎曼积分的定义以及黎曼可积的判别#10
english_title: Lebesgue Equivalent Condition for Riemann Integrability, Lebesgue and Vitali 1907
statement_en: A bounded function $f$ on the closed interval $[a,b]$ is Riemann integrable if and only if $f$ is continuous almost everywhere on this closed interval.
callout_body: 闭区间$[a,b]$上的有界函数$f$黎曼可积当且仅当函数$f$是在此闭区间上几乎处处连续的。
